question: Should explicit, session- and run-window-matched requester consumption count as terminal descendant delivery even if the requester's later outward send fails?
rationale: The code can enforce either boundary, but choosing whether internal requester consumption or external/user-visible delivery terminates descendant retry is a product and lifecycle contract decision.

options.title: Accept after proof
options.body: Treat exact matched requester consumption as delivered after the contributor demonstrates the persisted delivered-versus-retryable split on this head.

options.title: Require outward delivery
options.body: Keep descendant delivery pending until a user-visible delivery succeeds, preserving retries when requester output never reaches its final target.

options.title: Fold into durable inbox
options.body: Pause this PR and define the boundary as part of the broader durable completion inbox or spool design.

recommendation.title: Accept after proof
recommendation.body: Treat exact matched requester consumption as delivered after the contributor demonstrates the persisted delivered-versus-retryable split on this head.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest recent human provenance signal across the central cron and persisted registry paths affected by this decision.
